title: doola vs Northwest Registered Agent: Which LLC Service Should You Choose?
summary: doola vs Northwest Registered Agent on price, registered agent, non-US EINs, Form 5472, bookkeeping, and support. See which LLC service fits you.
body_markdown:
**If you live outside the US, don’t have an SSN, and need your EIN, bank account, Form 5472 filings and bookkeeping handled, doola is the better choice.** It covers all of it in one account, so nothing slips between vendors.


**The exception: If you live in the US, have an SSN, and already work with a CPA,** Northwest Registered Agent is a lower-cost option for a basic state filing and registered agent.


The doola vs Northwest Registered Agent debate comes down to a fundamental trade-off:


***Do you want a single operational partner that takes the back office off your plate, or a light-touch vendor that handles the filing and leaves the rest to you?***


**A quick note on transparency:** This guide is published by doola to help founders avoid paying for services they don’t need. Every claim about Northwest is verified against public data, and where Northwest is the better option for your circumstances, this guide says so directly.


State filing fees are excluded from plan prices throughout because state governments set those directly. The Wyoming cost example below adds them in so you can see a full total.


**Last verified:** October 2026. Prices come from each company’s public pricing pages on that date; links are in each section.


## The 10-Second Self-Test: Which Founder Are You?


Founder A (Global Entrepreneur / Hands-Off Builder)


You live outside the US (or operate across multiple countries), don’t have a US SSN, need a US bank account, and want to avoid $25,000 IRS penalties on Form 5472 filings without hiring three separate vendors. This is the founder doola is built for, and the profile this guide assumes by default.


**Your Pick:** doola. Start with Starter ($297/yr/yr) to form your LLC and get your EIN, or choose Tax & Compliance ($1,999/yr/yr) if you also want Form 5472 and your annual report filed for you.


Founder B (US Resident / DIY Builder)


You live in the US, have a Social Security Number, already have a local CPA, and only need a low-cost state filing with privacy protection.


**Your Pick:** Northwest Registered Agent ($39 + state fees)


## Why this Comparison Will Save You Thousands


Forming an LLC takes about 10 minutes these days. Running it without getting fined or shut down takes years.


Most founders pick a service based on day-one registration fees, only to get blindsided months later by hidden add-ons or missed compliance deadlines.


Here is what we uncover in the full analysis below before you spend a dollar:


- **The $200 Non-SSN Tax ID Gap:** Why getting an EIN without an SSN costs an extra $200 with one service but is included in the base plan with the other.


- **The $25,000 IRS Trap:** Why foreign-owned single-member LLCs owe IRS Form 5472 even with $0 in revenue, and how both platforms handle this high-stakes form.


- **True Year-2 Renewal Costs:** How a “$39 formation” can quietly scale into $500+ in separate add-on fees once you factor in registered agent renewals, annual report filings, and tax prep.

- **Privacy Protection:** Every formation plan includes a dedicated US business address that keeps your personal details off public records.


## Where Northwest Registered Agent Earns Its Reputation


Northwest has handled registered agent work out of Spokane, Washington since 1998 and holds a 4.7/5 rating on Google. Its service is built around one job: keeping a company’s state filings and registered agent in order.


For founders who want exactly that, its strengths are real:


- **Flat, Predictable Pricing** **:** Northwest charges $39 plus state filing fees, which includes a full year of registered agent service. After year one, registered agent coverage renews at $125/year.


- **Privacy by Default:** Under their default privacy policy, they list their own corporate address on official state filings wherever state law permits, keeping your personal home address off searchable government databases.


- **In-House Phone Support** **:** Their support team consists of in-house “Corporate Guides” who answer phone calls and emails directly.


What sits outside that core is most of what comes after the state filing. An EIN without an SSN is a $200 add-on, and bank applications, ITINs, bookkeeping, and federal tax filings like Form 5472 are left for you to source and coordinate with separate providers.


If you’re outside the US but only need an LLC and a registered agent, and you already have a CPA who handles Form 5472 for foreign-owned LLCs, Northwest can work for you too.

- **Beyond Mail Scanning:** While Northwest scans legal mail, doola receives your legal notices, obtains your EIN from the IRS, and unlocks US banking access. Add Tax & Compliance or Business-in-a-Box™ plan and your transactions sync directly into an automated bookkeeping ledger.

## Registered Agent Service and Privacy


Registered Agent Address vs US Business Address


These are two different things, and non-US founders often need both. Your registered agent address is where the state and courts send legal notices. Your business address is the one you use with banks, payment processors, customers and on invoices.


doola’s formation plans include a registered agent and a separate virtual US business address, and Northwest’s Privacy by Default policy puts its own address on your public state filings, so your personal address stays off public records either way.


- **doola:** Integrates registered agent service directly into its unified dashboard alongside bookkeeping ledgers, banking integrations, and tax filings.


- **Northwest:** Charges $125/year per state after year one, reduced to $100/year per state for businesses using its registered agent service in five or more states. Scans legal and official state mail and includes up to five free scans of regular business mail annually per state.


### Privacy Execution


Both services keep personal home details off public records. doola supplies a dedicated US business address on all formation plans, while Northwest uses its corporate address on state filings through its Privacy by Default policy


## Which Is Better for Non-US Founders?


For international entrepreneurs, these services represent two fundamentally different operational models:


- **doola (Turnkey Foreign Stack):** Designed specifically for non-US residents across 175+ countries. Non-SSN EIN acquisition is bundled into the Starter plan, ITIN assistance is available ($499 add-on), and upper tiers fully prepare mandatory Form 5472 filings.


- **Northwest (DIY Cross-Border Setup):** Accepts foreign founders, but charges an extra $200 for an EIN without an SSN or ITIN (processed manually by the IRS, which takes longer than the online application). They do not offer ITIN services, US banking setup assistance, or Form 5472 tax filings.


## Compliance, Annual Reports, and FinCEN Rules


In states like Wyoming, missing an annual report by 60 days results in administrative dissolution. That becomes an emergency when your bank locks your account and requests a Certificate of Good Standing that you can no longer pull.


- **doola:** Bundles state annual report filings directly into Tax & Compliance and Business-in-a-Box™ packages alongside federal IRS returns.


- **Northwest:** Sends compliance reminders and offers an annual report filing service for $100 per report plus state fees. Its website states that new registered agent customers are automatically enrolled in the renewal service, which can be canceled at any time.


Important Compliance Note


Under FinCEN’s Beneficial Ownership Information rules, domestic US entities formed through either service are permanently exempt from BOI reporting. Do not pay any provider for BOI filings.


Foreign companies registered to do business in the US still have to report BOI, and banks like Mercury still collect beneficial ownership details when you open an account under FinCEN’s Customer Due Diligence rule.


## Tax Support and Form 5472 Mechanics


Tax compliance is the widest gap between these two platforms. doola’s Tax & Compliance and Business-in-a-Box™ plans prepare and file your federal returns; Northwest does not prepare federal tax returns.


For non-US single-member LLC owners, IRS Form 5472 represents the highest operational risk:


- **Who Owes It:** Any foreign-owned single-member LLC (a “foreign-owned disregarded entity”) that engages in reportable transactions with its foreign owner or other related parties.


- **The Zero-Revenue Trap:** Initial capital contributions to establish the company or pay formation fees count as reportable transactions. That means you typically owe this form even with $0 in sales.


- **The Non-Filing Penalty:** The IRS can assess a $25,000 penalty per form, per year, for a late, missing or substantially incomplete filing, or for failing to keep required records, plus an additional $25,000 for each 30-day period the failure continues more than 90 days after the IRS sends notice.


- **Filing Mechanics:** It cannot be e-filed. It must be attached to a pro forma Form 1120 and sent by fax or mail by the 15th day of the 4th month after the tax year ends (April 15 for calendar-year LLCs). A 6-month extension is available by filing Form 7004 by the original due date.


- No tax due on the pro forma 1120: The pro forma Form 1120 is an information-only cover return and does not create corporate income tax for a single-member LLC.


doola’s Tax & Compliance ($1,999/yr/yr) and Business-in-a-Box™ ($2,999/yr/yr) tiers completely handle Form 5472 and pro forma 1120 preparation alongside state annual reports and CPA consultations.

- **Northwest:** Does not offer bookkeeping software, dedicated accounting, or banking application assistance.

## FAQs


#### How much does Northwest Registered Agent cost?


Northwest charges $39 plus state filing fees for initial LLC formation (includes year one registered agent service).


Registered agent service renews at $125/year. An EIN costs $50 (with an SSN or ITIN) or $200 (without either).


#### Does Northwest Registered Agent work if I live outside the US?


Yes. Northwest accepts foreign founders, but an EIN without an SSN or ITIN is a $200 add-on, and Northwest does not offer ITIN applications, bank account help or Form 5472 filing. You’d source those separately.


doola includes the non-SSN EIN in its Starter plan and offers banking help, ITIN applications and Form 5472 filing in the same account.


#### Can I open a US bank account as a non-resident?


Yes, with your EIN, formation documents and a passport, though the bank makes the final decision. Northwest doesn’t help with bank applications. doola helps you apply through partners like Mercury.


#### Do I need an ITIN to form a US LLC?


No. You can form an LLC and get an EIN without an SSN or ITIN. You may need an ITIN later if you have to file a personal US tax return.


If your LLC earns income effectively connected with a US trade or business, you may also need to file Form 1040-NR. Form 5472 does not replace it. doola offers an ITIN application service as a $499 add-on.


#### Is doola legit?


Yes. doola is a Y Combinator-backed company founded in 2020 that has launched over 25,000+ businesses across 175+ countries, with a 4.5 TrustScore on Trustpilot.


#### Does Northwest Registered Agent file taxes?


No. Northwest handles entity formation, registered agent duties, and state annual report filings (as a paid add-on). They do not prepare federal tax returns or IRS Form 5472.


#### Do I need to file Form 5472 if my LLC made no money?


In almost every case, yes. The filing is triggered by reportable transactions, not revenue.


A foreign owner funding the LLC or paying its formation fees counts as a reportable transaction, so most foreign-owned single-member LLCs owe Form 5472 for their first year even with $0 in sales.


The IRS penalty for missing Form 5472 starts at $25,000.


#### What happens if I miss Form 5472?


The IRS can assess a $25,000 penalty per form, per year, for a late, missing or substantially incomplete filing, plus an additional $25,000 for each 30-day period the failure continues more than 90 days after IRS notice.


Because the form can’t be e-filed and must be attached to a pro forma Form 1120, it’s easy to miss if no one owns the deadline.


#### Does doola guarantee a US business bank account?


No service can guarantee bank approval, as final decisions rest with the financial institution. However, doola assists founders with applying through banking partners such as Mercury.
